snapshot.text: Universal coverage through compulsory private basic health insurance, with premiums paid per person. Rising premiums and costs dominate policy; the Federal Council is pursuing cost-containment packages on medicines, tariffs and deductibles.

minister.name: Elisabeth Baume-Schneider
minister.role: Federal Councillor, head of the Federal Department of Home Affairs (health)

priorities.title: Discounts on top-selling medicines
priorities.text: The government wants volume discounts on popular drugs to curb premiums.

priorities.title: Higher minimum deductible
priorities.text: The Federal Council wants to raise the minimum deductible in basic health insurance.

priorities.title: Imposed tariff for doctors
priorities.text: The Federal Council is ready to impose its own tariff on doctors to curb costs.
